# testPackR

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of testPackR is to develop my package building capabilities. It is necessarily a bare bones package, allowing me to focus on workflows and best practice in building R packages.

## Installation

You can install the development version of testPackR from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("dr-rob-taylor/testPackR")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(testPackR)

## basic example code
add_two(5, 4)
```
